import importlib.util,json
from pathlib import Path
from arcpuzzles.parametric_worker import _real_evaluator
home=Path('generators/4295e17d5995/workspace/parametric')
def load(name):
    spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('final_semantic_review_'+name,home/(name+'.py'))
    module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module
p,r=load('prototype'),load('rivals')
seeds=(1,2,4,5,7,11,31,127,1024,2**63-1)
max_attempt=0
for seed in seeds:
    sampled=p.sample_inputs(seed,6,4)
    max_attempt=max(max_attempt,*sampled['attempts']['train'],*sampled['attempts']['test'])
    assert [tuple((len(g),len(g[0]))) for g in sampled['test']]==list(p.QUERY_SIZES)
    for setting in ({'wall_relation':'matching'},{'wall_relation':'opposite'}):
        assert p.demo_rival_failures([{'input':g,'output':p.solve(g,setting)} for g in sampled['train'][:2]],setting)==[]
print(json.dumps({'sampler_holdout_seeds':list(seeds),'successful_requests':len(seeds),'pairs_per_request':10,'maximum_draw_attempts':max_attempt,'cap':p.MAX_ATTEMPTS}))
sampled=p.sample_inputs(117,2,4)
grids=[sampled['train'][0],sampled['test'][3]]
apply,identity,bridge=_real_evaluator(Path('shared/runtime').resolve())
evals=0
try:
    for relation in p.SETTINGS:
        settings={'wall_relation':relation}
        for i,g in enumerate(grids):
            actual=apply(p.program(settings),g);evals+=1
            assert actual==p.solve(g,settings),(relation,i,'true')
            for name,code in r.programs(settings).items():
                actual=apply(code,g);evals+=1
                assert actual==p.solve_rival(g,settings,name),(relation,i,name)
    print(json.dumps({'racket_seed':117,'grids':['demo0','query30x30'],'settings':list(p.SETTINGS),'protected':identity['protected'],'racket_evaluations':evals,'all_true_and_rival_mirrors_match':True}))
finally:bridge.close()
